content:
Elena M: Quick sync  final SEO items for the webinar launch post + landing. Need a compact preflight: 3 focus keywords, JSON-LD (Event + FAQ), a short internal-link touch list, and a redirect CSV to run post-publish. Landing target is next Wed.

Omar R: For keywords propose: "LLM inference platform", "production LLM serving", "inference cost optimization". Ill draft meta description variants (under 155 chars).

Tara L: JSON-LD plan: Event + WebPage + 3 FAQ Q/As. Ill paste the Event snippet into the head and add FAQ in the body.

Devon P: Redirect CSV template ready. Ill include source,target,code and run 301s the evening after launch. Small sample: `/old-events/serving-llms,/events/serving-llms,301`.

Omar R: Internal link list: add CTAs from /docs/runtime, /product/features, /resources. Anchors: "low-latency serving", "dedicated capacity", "reduce inference costs". Ill open the PRs.

Elena M: Inbound routing: include utm params + webinar_id in webhook. Rule: company_size > 50 -> SDR queue, else -> nurture. Add field `interested_in`. @Devon confirm payload keys.

Devon P: Confirmed. Payload includes email, first_name, last_name, company, company_size (int), utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, webinar_id, interested_in. Returns 200 on success.

Tara L: Two hero copy variants for modal A/B: A) "Ship LLM features with predictable latency" B) "Cut inference cost while keeping SLAs". Run 50/50 for first 1k impressions and report CTR + signups.

Elena M: Timeline: blog draft Tue, landing Wed (1788892400), redirect sweep Wed night. Owners: Tara (schema/copy), Devon (redirects/webhook), Omar (meta/internal links), Elena (PM).

SEO-bot: Task created  MARKETING-7321 "webinar landing SEO + redirects" (https://trello.company/board/card/MARKETING-7321).

Elena M: Thanks team  will post the draft link here when ready. Any blockers?

Omar R: None from Eng. :thumbsup:
